assessments.summary: The supplied argument establishes the claim without external dependencies. It derives the universal bound M≤G(P_S)+2r, maximizes G on both symmetry classes of three-symbol faces to obtain M<0.695, constructs the finite independently repeated randomized-time-division witness with exact value B_{1/6}=0.723171009237413…>0.7231, and uses indicator decomposition plus certified face bounds to prove the strict mass floors P_S(00),P_S(11)>1/180 and P_S(01),P_S(10)>1/325 for every witness strictly improving on twice the optimal one-letter RTD value.
scopeQualifications: The result concerns the unnormalized two-letter Marton functional for the half-skew BSSC product channel.
It is a support-pruning theorem only; it does not prove that full-support Marton laws cannot yield a gain.
It is not a converse for unrestricted broadcast coding or a determination of unrestricted sum capacity.
The numerical attestation supports the finite algebraic and numerical inequalities, while the universal Marton reduction and calculus steps are established in the written proof.
